api.close: Idempotent terminal disposal; also called by _exit_tree.
api.request_after_close: Returns 0 and schedules no completion or dispatch.

preservation: close clears only in-memory callback/timer/request ownership. It never deletes or rolls back primary, previous, pending, event or outbox records. Policy and selection cancellation paths were not edited.

static_checks.scope: Manual source/diff inspection and SHA256 comparisons only.
static_checks.diff_command: git diff --no-index between preserved store preimage and current store; exit 1 is expected because changes exist.

prepared_tests: Queued valid host delivery then close; late host reply and timeout remain silent.
Tree exit closes immediately; reattachment cannot reopen.
Native deferred record is revoked before disk access.
Real native transaction lock creates a retry; close disconnects timer and blocks an already deferred retry after lock release.
Committed answer/outbox and all primary/previous/pending bytes survive close; new store loads and deduplicates event, then explicitly acknowledges reward.
before_commit closing the store prevents the remaining native write.
coordination: Root owns Play/session and game_ui terminal disposal. Loader agent owns loader close. New dedicated suite is not added to tools/run-tests.cjs; root must coordinate its explicit execution and any group wiring.
limitations: Not parsed or executed in Godot; runtime verification is pending.
A host operation dispatched before close may already have committed externally. Close revokes local delivery, not durable work; later store recovery remains authoritative.
